ogre_magi_fireblast.desc: Smashes an enemy with a wave of fire, dealing magical damage and stunning it. Multicast repeats it on the same target.

ogre_magi_ignite.desc: Hurls flaming liquid at an enemy and at one more random enemy nearby. Burning units take magical damage every second and are slowed; repeat hits extend the burn. Multicast throws more at random enemies.

ogre_magi_bloodlust.desc: Drives a friendly unit or tower into a frenzy, raising its attack and movement speed; Ogre gets a bigger attack speed bonus on himself. Can autocast. Multicast spreads it to random allies nearby.

ogre_magi_dumb_luck.desc: Ogre never gains Intelligence. Instead his maximum mana and mana regeneration grow with his Strength.

ogre_magi_multicast.desc: Ogre's targeted spells may fire two, three or four times in a row. Every point of Strength adds a little to the chance.
